acceptanceCriteria: An owner decision records default-on or keep-opt-in; if default-on, parity fixtures, the divergence register and MTV-V0-005 are updated with tests.
body: PR #1313 (PUB-V0-027..030) adds an opt-in `--producer` member to impact/test-validity receipts. Default-on would change CCF-V1-006 parity bytes, the VSC envelope exactKeys and MTV-V0-005 CLI/MCP equality, so it needs an owner decision, a divergence-register entry and a parity note.
title: Decide whether receipts carry the producer member by default (V1-2043 residual)
